knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A worst-case selection tests the hardest realistic situation, so that a method that passes it is expected to pass the easier ones.
These areas are awkward to clean, and the guide wants them swabbed with a stated reason.
With one product, there are fewer carry-over products to assess, although a cleaning procedure is still needed.

practicalCriteria: Learner names the worst-case product for a two-product item and gives the reason (pass: choice and reason recorded).
Learner names three awkward areas and justifies each (pass: three areas with reasons).
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Worst-case selection note for one item
stopWorkCriteria: A product is potent or toxic and the handling controls are not known.
A configuration cannot be inspected or sampled safely.
